site.name: MVPS Speaks
site.tagline: Manvasa Vidya Public School — Student Voice Platform

hero.headline: STUDENTS KI AWAAZ
hero.body: Garmi mein school, heatwave alert ke baad bhi classes — yeh sahi nahi hai. Yahan students apni baat keh sakte hain — bina darr ke, bina login ke.

demands.title: Summer Vacation Do
demands.body: IMD ne heatwave red alert jaari kiya hai UP mein. Temperatures 45°C+ hain. Doosre states mein schools band hain — MVPS mein kyun nahi?

demands.title: School Timing Badlo
demands.body: Agar vacation nahi deni toh kam se kam timings subah 7 baje se 11 baje kar do — jaise baaki UP ke schools kar rahe hain.

demands.title: Paani Aur Cooling Ki Vyavastha
demands.body: Classes ke beech adequate water breaks aur fans/coolers ka proper arrangement hona chahiye. Students ki health pehle hai.

complaint_page.headline: APNI BAAT KAHO
complaint_page.subheadline: Har complaint record hoti hai. Director tak pahunchti hai.
complaint_page.note: Tumhari identity safe hai. Anonymous submission ka option available hai.
instructions: Anonymous rehna chahte ho toh naam mat bharein
Submit karne ke baad complaint record ho jaati hai
Hum ise concerned authorities tak pahunchayenge

footer.tagline: Students ke liye, students ke dwara.
footer.disclaimer: Yeh ek independent student platform hai. MVPS school se affiliated nahi hai.
